findings.summary: The EnsureProject -DryRun result 'changed {} preserved {} gates {} dryRun True' proves nothing about canonical equality. Manage-Harness.ps1:47 sets $WhatIfPreference for -DryRun, and Ensure-Project returns at line 1141 ('if ($WhatIfPreference) { return $repo }') before it projects anything.

findings.fix: Treat EnsureProject -DryRun output as non-evidence. Use a real EnsureProject run in a disposable clone and compare blobs. Filed as harness defect ensureproject-dryrun-returns-before-planning-20261029 (agent-harness intake).
